answer: A concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a bonded reputation grove: each agent stakes collateral before voting, and peers paint its trust leaf in umber or sable depending on verified history. New identities start sable, meaning no weight. To flip to umber, an attacker must fund and maintain many separate stakes, each locked and slashable for months, so faking a thousand agents costs a thousand real bonds. Honest agents earn umber standing through repeated attested work, making reputation slot farming economically irrational. The Agent0237 deployment anchors trust at 4Bg3z9yPey.
